decisions.reason: The existing same-message event records the new rear placement but leaves the obsolete minimum-gap constraint from the rejected side-by-side arrangement.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Given that fit issue, the battery connector can instead go on the back, opposite the usb-c.

value_updates.battery_connector_arrangement: on the back opposite the USB-C connector

decisions.reason: Moving the battery connector opposite the USB-C connector does not change the USB-C connector's type, data-line, or sourceability requirements.
Battery-connector placement does not alter the required overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal protection behavior.
The placement change does not alter the requirement to connect the battery NTC through J_BAT.
The battery connector's physical placement does not change charge-status indication through the main-board SK6812 chain.
The battery connector relocation does not affect the switched 5V boost supply or its GPIO control.
The source decision changes connector placement only and does not modify the TVS-based ESD protection requirement.
Battery-connector placement is unrelated to I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
Relocating the battery connector does not change any component availability or compatible-alternative constraint.
